connector.name: SchemaSure - structured extraction
connector.registryDescription: Extract schema-valid JSON from text/HTML or document images. Pay per call via x402 V2.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package schemasure. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the noamjose account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SCHEMASURE_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of SchemaSure. Text has free V1 evaluation without a wallet; image extraction is V2-only and always requires a wallet.

env.name: SCHEMASURE_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional 0x-prefixed EVM key. Enables paid x402 V2 text and image calls; signs Base USDC payments locally. Never sent to SchemaSure.

env.name: SCHEMASURE_MAX_PRICE_USD
env.description: Client-side spend cap in USD per call (paid mode). The client refuses to pay more than this, even if the server advertises a higher price.
